lines.en: label startsleepover:
scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: Uhh...Ami?
lines.zh: : 呃……Ami？

lines.en: : Yes, dearest uncle?
lines.zh: : 在呢，最亲爱的叔叔？

lines.en: : Would you mind...you know...reminding me what the name of the city we live in is?
lines.zh: : 你介不介意……那个……提醒我一下我们住的城市叫什么名字？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: Jeez, even that's gone?
lines.zh: : 天啊，连这个都忘了？

lines.en: : Just assume that {i}everything{/i} is already gone since it'll wind up saving the two of us a ton of time.
lines.zh: : 干脆就当{i}所有东西{/i}都忘了吧，这样能替我们俩省下大把时间。

lines.en: : Not {i}everything{/i} is gone, Sensei. I'm sure your love for me would remain no matter what sort of crazy thing happened to your brain.
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}全{/i}忘了吗，Sensei。我相信，不管你的脑子出了什么岔子，你对我的爱都还在。

lines.en: : But, you're right. It's already kinda late out and I should be spending less time questioning you and more time helping you get back to normal.
lines.zh: : 不过你说得对。天已经有点晚了，我应该少花点时间盘问你，多花点时间帮你恢复正常。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath3
: So, allow me to {i}re-{/i}introduce you to Kumon-mi! A super normal town just outside of Tokyo.
lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我{i}重{/i}新为你介绍 Kumon-mi！东京郊外一座超级普通的小镇。

lines.en: : We’re not allowed to leave the city limits anymore because of the war, but-
lines.zh: : 因为战争，我们已经不准离开市界了，不过——

lines.en: : Wait, war? What war?
lines.zh: : 等等，战争？什么战争？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: The same war we've been in for years now.
lines.zh: : 就是我们打了好些年的那场战争啊。

lines.en: : Like 99%% of the men were drafted into the space army and are off fighting aliens right now or something.
lines.zh: : 大概 99%% 的男人都被征进了太空军，现在正在外头跟外星人打仗什么的。

lines.en: : Is this...some sort of joke? Or...
lines.zh: : 这是……在开玩笑吧？还是……

lines.en: : Joke? No. It's super real.
lines.zh: : 玩笑？不是。这超级真实。

lines.en: : And you should be thankful you weren't one of the people who got drafted since you're a teacher and we need more people like you to make sure everyone in our class doesn't wind up like Miku.
lines.zh: : 而且你该庆幸自己没被征走，因为你是老师，我们需要更多像你这样的人，来确保我们班上没有一个人变成 Miku 那样。

lines.en: I have no idea who that even is...
lines.zh: 我连那是谁都不知道……

lines.en: : Is the war really in space, though?...
lines.zh: : 不过战争真的在太空里吗？……

lines.en: : Of course. It's an important aspect of the plot that is going to be used as comedic relief in the future, so don't try and focus too much on it or you'll wind up getting distracted from everything else.
lines.zh: : 当然。这是剧情里很重要的一个设定，以后还要拿来当笑料用的，所以你别太纠结这个，不然会分心，错过其他所有事情。

lines.en: : Everything else meaning {i}what,{/i} exactly? Are there some other...weird rules about this place I need to be lectured on now?
lines.zh: : “其他所有事情”{i}具体指什么{/i}？这地方还有什么别的……古怪规矩，是现在得听你给我上一课的吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath4
: A few! But really, the hardest part of everything is that the girl-to-boy ratio is completely out of whack and I wouldn't be surprised if you go weeks or months without seeing other men sometimes!
lines.zh: : 有几条！不过说真的，最难的地方在于男女比例完全失衡，你要是有时好几周甚至好几个月都见不到别的男人，我都不会觉得意外！

lines.en: : I see no problem with this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这没什么问题。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath5
: Well, you should. That's the part where you were supposed to say, “You're the only girl for me, Ami! I don't care about any of the other ones!”
lines.zh: : 不，你应该觉得有问题。这时候你本该说的是：“Ami，你是我的唯一！其他那些我一个都不在乎！”

lines.en: : Aren't we related?
lines.zh: : 我们不是亲戚吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath6
: Enough about that, how 'bout we get back to some of those rules you were just talking about?
lines.zh: : 这个话题到此为止，我们还是回到你刚才说的那些规矩上吧？

lines.en: : Are we really going to ignore the blatant incestuous undertones you-
lines.zh: : 我们真的要无视你话里那明晃晃的乱伦意味吗——

lines.en: : Rule number one is keep your hands off all of your students! But that should probably be a rule that goes without saying since...you know.
lines.zh: : 第一条规矩：不许对你的学生动手！不过这条大概本来就不言自明，毕竟……你懂的。

lines.en: : Is that, like...an Ami rule? Or is that an actual school rule?
lines.zh: : 那是……算是你的规矩？还是学校真正的规矩？

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure it's a law. But it's also a school rule.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定是法律。同时也是校规。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath7
: Technically, the rule only applies to school grounds, though...since no one can really keep track of what you do elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 不过严格来说，这条规矩只在校园范围内适用……毕竟没人能一直盯着你在别处做什么。

lines.en: : Right...and is there anything else I should be worried about?
lines.zh: : 这样啊……那还有什么我该注意的吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: Probably! So just ask me whatever comes to mind and I'll help you out the best I can!
lines.zh: : 大概有！所以想到什么尽管问，我会尽我所能帮你的！

lines.en: label amiwhattodo:
menu:
Tell me about my students
lines.zh: 跟我说说我的学生

lines.en: : Can you tell me a little bit about my class?
lines.zh: : 你能跟我讲讲我们班吗？

lines.en: : You mean {i}remind{/i} you a little about your class?
lines.zh: : 你是说，帮你{i}回忆{/i}一下你们班？

lines.en: : Yeah...that. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 对……就是这个。抱歉。

lines.en: : Don't apologize to {i}me,{/i} Sensei. I'm used to dealing with you when you're at your worst. This sort of thing doesn't bother me at all.
lines.zh: : 别跟{i}我{/i}道歉，Sensei。我早就习惯对付状态最差时的你了。这种事我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : You're the only male teacher at an all-girls school...and there are ten total students you’re in charge of- including me!
lines.zh: : 你是一所女校里唯一的男老师……你负责的学生总共十个人——包括我！

lines.en: : Our school works a little different from the other high school in that we’re in your care for every class of the day.
lines.zh: : 我们学校跟另一所高中不太一样，一整天所有的课都由你负责。

lines.en: : Sometimes, a student or two might not show up to class. A couple of them have cutting problems.
lines.zh: : 有时候会有一两个学生不来上课。她们中有几个有自残的问题。

lines.en: : I also think I heard something about more students joining later on in the year as well!
lines.zh: : 我还听说，这一年晚些时候可能还会有更多学生加入！

lines.en: : Sometimes, classes get a little crowded and people need to be moved around and stuff.
lines.zh: : 有时候班级会有点挤，需要把人调来调去什么的。

lines.en: : Oh, in addition to being our teacher, you’re also our guidance counselor!
lines.zh: : 哦，除了当我们的老师，你还是我们的升学指导顾问！

lines.en: : Some of the girls have issues they have a hard time discussing, so getting them to open up is part of your job.
lines.zh: : 有些女孩子有难以启齿的烦恼，所以让她们敞开心扉也是你的工作之一。

lines.en: : Since the semester has only just begun, some of them are still in the process of warming up to you.
lines.zh: : 因为学期才刚开始，她们中有些人还在慢慢跟你熟络起来。

lines.en: : Oh! But then there are also some girls like Ayane and Maya who you've known for years since they come to our house to sleep over all the time.
lines.zh: : 哦！不过也有 Ayane 和 Maya 这样的女孩，她们总来我们家过夜，所以你已经认识她们好多年了。

lines.en: : If you have any more specific questions about them, it would probably be better to check that weird book thingy you always keep lying around in your room.
lines.zh: : 如果你还有更具体的问题，最好去看看你房间里老是随手扔着的那本奇怪的本子。

lines.en: : Book thingy?
lines.zh: : 奇怪的本子？

lines.en: : I'm not really sure what it is since you won't let me look inside, but I'm pretty sure it's like...info on all of the students or something.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定那是什么，因为你从不让我看里面，但我猜大概是……所有学生的资料之类的。

lines.en: : Probably school related stuff since I know you'd never hide anything from me. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 应该是学校相关的东西吧，毕竟我知道你什么事都不会瞒我。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. Sure.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。当然。

lines.en: : Great!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: : So, any other questions?
lines.zh: : 那么，还有别的问题吗？

lines.en: jump amiwhattodo
Where are your parents?
lines.zh: 你父母在哪儿？

lines.en: : What about your parents? Why aren't you staying with them instead of-
lines.zh: : 你父母呢？你为什么不跟他们住在一起而是——

lines.en: : Ask something else.
lines.zh: : 换个问题。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : {i}Ask something else.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}换个问题。{/i}

lines.en: jump amiwhattodo
What should I do?
lines.zh: 我该怎么办？

lines.en: : So...what should I do?
lines.zh: : 那么……我该做些什么？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...apart from teaching and...counseling or all of the other stuff my job requires me to do.
lines.zh: : 就是……除了教书和……咨询，或者我工作要求的其他那些事情之外。

lines.en: : I guess what I'm asking is...what is a normal day like for me?
lines.zh: : 我想问的是……我平常的一天是什么样的？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: Oh, okay! Gotcha.
lines.zh: : 哦，好！明白了。

lines.en: : I don't know. That's kind of a tough question.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这问题有点难。

lines.en: : There's tons to do in Kumon-mi. And I'm sure you'll find plenty of ways to keep yourself entertained when you're not working or hanging out with me.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 有的是事情可做。而且我相信，不工作、不陪我的时候，你也能找到很多消遣的方式。

lines.en: : You know, I kind of figured a girl your age would be a little more interested in spending time with her friends rather than her uncle.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我本来以为你这个年纪的女孩会更想跟朋友待在一起，而不是跟叔叔。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath8
: I...can do both!
lines.zh: : 我……两个都可以兼顾！

lines.en: : And I won't let you make me feel like a loser because I like being closer to someone with the same blood as me!
lines.zh: : 而且我不会让你因为我和我有血缘关系的人更亲近，就让我觉得自己是个失败者！

lines.en: : Having the same blood is just a pretty specific thing to look for in a companion is all.
lines.zh: : 只是“有相同的血液”这个择伴标准还挺特别的。

lines.en: : I just told you! I won't let you make me feel like a loser just because I like spending time with you!
lines.zh: : 我刚说过了！我不会让你因为我喜欢跟你待在一起，就让我觉得自己是个失败者！

lines.en: : And I won't try to do that anymore, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我以后大概不会再这么做了。

lines.en: : Again, I'm just trying to figure out how to use what little free time I'll have and...no offense, but I'm sure not all of it will be spent on you.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我只是想弄清楚该怎么利用我那点可怜的自由时间，而且……无意冒犯，但我敢肯定它们不会全花在你身上。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath2
: You can't just say “No offense” right before saying something super offensive, Sensei. It doesn't work that way.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不能先说“无意冒犯”然后马上接一句超级冒犯的话。这不是这么用的。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath1
: But I guess expecting you to speak normally is a little much to ask since everything else seems to be different about you today anyway!
lines.zh: : 不过我想，指望你正常说话也有点强人所难，反正你今天其他方面看起来都怪怪的！

lines.en: : So, is there anything else you want to know?
lines.zh: : 那么，还有什么想知道的吗？

lines.en: jump amiwhattodo
Tell me more about the war
lines.zh: 跟我说说那场战争

lines.en: : Can you tell me more about that war you mentioned earlier?
lines.zh: : 你能再多讲讲你刚才提到的那场战争吗？

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : Oh.
: Oh, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。

lines.en: : Anything else you want to know?
lines.zh: : 还有别的想知道的吗？

lines.en: jump amiwhattodo
Let's just move on
lines.zh: 就到这里吧

lines.en: jump nextstart
label nextstart:
: I think I know everything I need to. Let's just go home and I'll...figure the rest out from there.
lines.zh: : 我想我需要知道的都知道了。我们回家吧，剩下的……我再慢慢想办法。

lines.en: : Cool! In that case, I-
lines.zh: : 好！那我——

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath9
: Ah! Wait!
lines.zh: : 啊！等等！

lines.en: : What? What's wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？出什么事了？

lines.en: : What's {i}wrong-{/i} is that Maya has been sitting all by herself over there this entire time and we haven't even noticed her.
lines.zh: : {i}出什么事{/i}了——Maya 从头到尾都一个人坐在那边，而我们居然一直没注意到她。

lines.en: : Maya! We're coming to say hello whether you like it or not!
lines.zh: : Maya！不管你乐不乐意，我们都要过来打招呼了！

lines.en: scene black
Ami charges away from me and I am stricken with the harsh realization that I might not be getting home as early as I was anticipating...
lines.zh: Ami 从我身边冲了出去，而我被一个残酷的念头击中——我可能没法像预想的那么早回家了……

lines.en: scene mayacg1
I stop caring about that the moment I see her friend, though.
lines.zh: 不过，一看到她那位朋友，我就不在意这个了。

lines.en: If I'm remembering correctly, this is one of the girls that Ami claims I've known for years.
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这就是 Ami 说我认识了好多年的女孩之一。

lines.en: Hopefully, that means I've already got some decent footing with her and that my...romantic options are not limited solely to an extremely clingy family member.
lines.zh: 希望这意味着我跟她已经有些不错的基础，而我的……恋爱选项也不至于只剩下一个黏人到极点的家人。

lines.en: : Hello! Earth to Maya! Ami and Sensei reporting in.
lines.zh: : 你好！Maya，地球呼叫！Ami 和 Sensei 前来报到。

lines.en: : Yes. Sensei. That is who I am.
lines.zh: : 对。Sensei。我就是这个人。

lines.en: scene mayacg2
: Hm?
The girl suddenly looks up, ignoring Ami and locking eyes with me for an uncomfortably long time.
lines.zh: 女孩突然抬起头，无视了 Ami，与我对视了长到让人不适的一段时间。

lines.en: Well...in all actuality, it's probably only a few seconds. But her gaze is piercing enough to make it feel longer.
lines.zh: 嗯……实际上大概只有几秒钟。可她的目光太过锐利，让人觉得漫长得得多。

lines.en: : Sorry, who did you say you were again?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你刚才说你是谁来着？

lines.en: : ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ……Sensei？

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...yes?
scene mayacg3
: Don’t mind him. He’s just tired from his nap. You saw him sleeping at the end of class, right?
lines.zh: : 别管他。他只是午睡没睡醒。你不是看到他在课快结束时睡着了吗？

lines.en: scene mayacg4
: Yes. Which, might I add, is a thing I'm {i}pretty{/i} sure teachers aren't supposed to be doing.
lines.zh: : 是啊。顺便说一句，我{i}敢肯定{/i}老师是不该做这种事的。

lines.en: : You can talk to me directly, you know. You don't have to relay your problems with me to Ami.
lines.zh: : 你可以直接跟我说，你知道的。你不必把对我的意见通过 Ami 转达。

lines.en: scene mayacg6
: Pass.
lines.zh: : 免了。

lines.en: : Don’t mind Maya. She can be a little...grumpy at times. I'm sure it's nothing personal.
lines.zh: : 别在意 Maya。她有时候是有点……暴躁。我敢肯定她不是针对你。

lines.en: scene mayacg5
: I wouldn't be {i}too{/i} sure if I were you.
lines.zh: : 换作是我，可不会{i}这么肯定{/i}。

lines.en: Okay. Maybe knowing this girl for years is not quite enough to put me on good footing with her just yet.
lines.zh: 好吧。看来认识这个女孩好些年，也还不足以让我跟她打好关系。

lines.en: For the time being, my options remain limited to just one.
lines.zh: 目前为止，我的选项仍然只有一个。

lines.en: scene mayacg4
: Oh, Maya. Are you still planning on coming over tomorrow night?
lines.zh: : 对了，Maya。你明天晚上还打算来过夜吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure you don't want to come to the dorm instead?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想改成来宿舍吗？

lines.en: : Are you only saying that because it's our turn to take out the trash?
lines.zh: : 你这么说，该不会只是因为轮到我们倒垃圾了吧？

lines.en: : Only? No. But I would be lying if I said that was not one of many factors contributing to how little I want to be in the same building as your uncle.
lines.zh: : 只是？不。但如果我说这不是构成“我有多不想和你叔叔待在同一栋楼”的众多因素之一，那我就是在撒谎。

lines.en: : You're in the same building as him every day, though.
lines.zh: : 可你每天都跟他待在同一栋楼里啊。

lines.en: : I know. It's horrible.
lines.zh: : 我知道。糟透了。

lines.en: scene mayacg5
: Sensei! You're okay with Maya sleeping over tomorrow, right? Ayane is probably going to come too but she might have some stuff to do with Sana instead.
lines.zh: : Sensei！Maya 明天来过夜你没意见吧？Ayane 大概也会来，不过她可能要跟 Sana 一起做点别的事。

lines.en: : I won't really know until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 这个得等明天才知道。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. Do whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 行，当然。你们随意。

lines.en: It's not like I'm going to complain about even {i}more{/i} attractive teenagers with preexisting ties to me being invited over to my house.
lines.zh: 我可不会抱怨又有{i}更{/i}多和我早有交情的漂亮少女被请到家里来。

lines.en: Unless this Ayane girl also feels the same way Maya does about me, which...would really call into question just who the previous Sensei was as a person.
lines.zh: 除非这个叫 Ayane 的女孩跟 Maya 一样讨厌我，那……可就真要让人怀疑上任 Sensei 到底是个什么样的人了。

lines.en: scene mayacg6
: Please go straight to your room once you get home tomorrow and do not leave until {i}I{/i} leave. Can you do that?
lines.zh: : 明天你一回家就请直接回房间，在{i}我{/i}离开之前不要出来。你能做到吗？

lines.en: : Do you really dislike me that much?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么讨厌我吗？

lines.en: : I think {i}abhor{/i} is a better word, but yes.
lines.zh: : 我觉得用“{i}憎恶{/i}”更贴切，不过，是的。

lines.en: scene black
Ami and I don't stick around for much longer as Maya has to return to the dorm for...some reason she probably made up as an excuse to get away from me.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 没待太久，因为 Maya 得回宿舍去……理由大概是她为了躲我现编的借口。

lines.en: And while I'm still confused about why she's treating me with such disdain after barely saying anything to her, I'm not going to dwell on it for too long.
lines.zh: 虽然我到现在也不明白，她几乎没跟我说过话，为什么就这么厌恶我，但我不打算在这上面纠结太久。

lines.en: There are plenty of other girls I'm going to be meeting soon, and expecting all of them to like me right away would be...
lines.zh: 我很快还会认识很多别的女孩，而指望她们全都一开始就喜欢我，那……

lines.en: Well, let's just say it wouldn't be any fun at all.
lines.zh: 嗯，这么说吧，那就一点意思都没有了。

lines.en: This life is already proving to be full of conveniences and windows of opportunity that I would have expected to remain locked indefinitely given the type of person I am.
lines.zh: 鉴于我是这样的人，这种种便利和机会之窗本该永远对我紧闭，可如今这种生活已经证明，它们比比皆是。

lines.en: If {i}everything{/i} was like that and there were no windows I had to pry open myself-
lines.zh: 如果{i}一切{/i}都是那样，没有一扇需要我亲手撬开的窗——

lines.en: I can't imagine I'd be happy.
lines.zh: 我想我是不会幸福的。

lines.en: Conveniences are only blessings in small doses. Once they surround you, they become the norm and detach from any sort of {i}convenience{/i} at all.
lines.zh: 便利只有在小剂量时才是恩赐。一旦它们把你包围，就变成了常态，也就跟{i}“便利”{/i}二字彻底脱钩了。

lines.en: I want something to chase after.
lines.zh: 我想要有东西可以追逐。

lines.en: And I have already found at least {i}one{/i} thing with a substantial head start.
lines.zh: 而我至少已经找到了{i}一个{/i}遥遥领先的目标。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath10
: So, here we are! Home sweet home.
lines.zh: : 好了，我们到家了！甜蜜的家。

lines.en: : Huh...It’s actually pretty nice in here.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这里面其实挺不错的。

lines.en: : I’d hope so! You {i}do{/i} live here after all.
lines.zh: : 那当然！毕竟你就{i}是{/i}住在这儿啊。

lines.en: : I'm assuming you're the one who keeps things this...clean?
lines.zh: : 我猜，把这里保持得这么……干净的人是你吧？

lines.en: : Mhm! So you don't have to worry about any of that stuff and can just relax whenever you're home. I'll take care of the rest.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！所以你完全不用操心这些事，在家只管放松就好。剩下的都交给我。

lines.en: : I {i}might{/i} ask you to take the trash out if the bags are too heavy, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是垃圾袋太重，我{i}可能{/i}会请你去倒一下。

lines.en: : Oh, that reminds me-
lines.zh: : 哦，这倒提醒我了——

lines.en: : Uhh...Maya said something about dorms, didn't she?
lines.zh: : 呃……Maya 刚才提到了宿舍，是吧？

lines.en: : How come you're living here instead of over there? Isn't that where everyone else is?
lines.zh: : 你为什么住在这儿而不是那儿？其他人不都在那边吗？

lines.en: scene black
Ami spins around and greets me with a stare that leads me to believe this isn't the first time she's been asked something like this.
lines.zh: Ami 转过身来，用一种让我意识到“她绝不是第一次被问这种问题”的眼神看着我。

lines.en: I'm sure her apparent clinginess has something to do with it but, at the same time, it's not like the dorms would be {i}that{/i} far away, right?
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她{i}那{/i}明显的黏人跟这事有关，可话说回来，宿舍也没远到哪儿去吧？

lines.en: Is she really so dependent on me that she can't even {i}begin{/i} tearing herself away?
lines.zh: 她真的依赖我到连{i}试着离开{/i}一步都做不到的地步吗？
{i}还是说……{/i}

lines.en: Is it maybe the other way around?
lines.zh: 也许恰恰相反？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath11
: Are you trying to get rid of me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是想把我赶走吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. I just figured that most girls your age would never turn down the opportunity to live with their friends.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我只是觉得，你这个年纪的女孩多半不会拒绝和朋友一起住的机会。

lines.en: : And I'm sure you know {i}all{/i} about what girls want...right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那你肯定{i}很懂{/i}女孩子想要什么咯……对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : You still call me that even when we’re home?
lines.zh: : 就算在家里，你也还是这么叫我？

lines.en: : Is that weird?
lines.zh: : 这样很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 是有点，对。

lines.en: : Well, you better get used to it. Because I've been calling you that for so long that anything else would just make me feel...weird.
lines.zh: : 那你最好习惯一下。因为我这么叫你都叫了这么久，换成别的反而会让我觉得……很怪。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath12
: Besides! I think it makes things kinda fun! It's almost like we're role-playing or something! Just...we're playing our actual roles and not...creative ones.
lines.zh: : 再说！我觉得这样还挺有趣的！简直就像我们在玩角色扮演什么的！只不过……我们演的就是真实的自己，而不是……编出来的角色。

lines.en: : Well...whatever makes you happy, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……只要你开心就好，我想。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath13
: Anyway, I'm gonna go get dressed and start preparing dinner. Is there anything you want to eat tonight or should I just...do whatever?
lines.zh: : 总之，我要去换衣服、准备晚饭了。你今晚想吃点什么，还是我……随便做？

lines.en: : Just do whatever. I'm not really that picky.
lines.zh: : 随便做就好。我不是很挑。

lines.en: : Works for me!
lines.zh: : 正合我意！

lines.en: : If your brain is still being weird, you should use this time to check out that book thingy I was telling you about earlier.
lines.zh: : 如果你的脑子还是不太对劲，就趁现在去看看我刚才说的那本本子吧。

lines.en: : Going to work tomorrow without any idea of who the other girls are could get really nasty really quickly. So, for your safety, take your time and try to {i}at least{/i} remember everybody's names.
lines.zh: : 明天要是对其他女孩一无所知就去上班，很快就会变得很难收拾。所以为了你自己好，慢慢来，{i}至少{/i}把每个人的名字记住。

lines.en: : Sure. But, uhh...
lines.zh: : 好。不过，呃……

lines.en: : What's wrong? Change of heart for dinner? You looking for something specific now?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？晚饭改主意了？现在有特别想吃的东西了？

lines.en: : No, I just...
lines.zh: : 不，我只是……

lines.en: : Which door leads to my room again?
lines.zh: : 哪一扇门是通向我房间的来着？

lines.en: scene black
scene bathscenebutnomorebath14
I step into my room after Ami points it out to me and am quickly greeted by the sight of a bedroom slightly less...mature than I was expecting.
lines.zh: Ami 给我指了路，我走进自己的房间，映入眼帘的卧室比我预想的……稍微不那么成熟一点。

lines.en: If I'm a full-time teacher and homeowner, I think it's probably time to ditch the model kits and game consoles, but...
lines.zh: 既然我是全职老师又有自己的房子，我想大概是时候把那些模型套件和游戏机扔掉了，不过……

lines.en: Then again, I guess I shouldn't be bashing the previous owner of this body after they ever-so-kindly presented me with what tons of other men would deem as a perfect, dream scenario.
lines.zh: 话又说回来，这具身体的前任主人好心给了我一个无数男人梦寐以求的完美剧本，我也不该再贬低他了。

lines.en: Come to think of it...
lines.zh: 说起来……

lines.en: I wonder what happened to the old Sensei?
lines.zh: 不知道原来的 Sensei 怎么样了？

lines.en: Or, better yet-
lines.zh: 或者，更好的问题是——

lines.en: I wonder what happened to the old {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: 不知道原来的{i}我{/i}怎么样了？

lines.en: scene whyme
scene whythesky
scene whygodwhy
scene bathscenebutnomorebath14
Probably nothing.
lines.zh: 大概什么也没发生吧。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath15
The first thing I approach is a leatherback journal positioned on the center of a nearby coffee table.
lines.zh: 我首先走向的，是旁边那张茶几正中央放着的一本皮面日记本。

lines.en: Without even opening it, I already know this is the book Ami was talking about earlier.
lines.zh: 还没翻开，我就已经知道这就是 Ami 刚才说的那本本子。

lines.en: Why it's just...sitting out here in the open if it supposedly contains classified information on my students- I have no idea.
lines.zh: 如果里面真有学生的机密资料，它为什么就这么……大剌剌地摆在外面，我是想不明白。

lines.en: But seeing as I was just talking to you about conveniences a moment ago, I don't think something like this is {i}too{/i} out of the ordinary.
lines.zh: 但想想我刚刚才跟你聊过“便利”这回事，我觉得这种事也不算{i}太{/i}出格。

lines.en: Or...at least what ordinary is shaping out to be so far.
lines.zh: 或者说……至少就目前“平常”所呈现出的样子而言。

lines.en: scene black
I open the book and flip through a few pages of notes I don't want to be bothered with before reaching the section I'm looking for.
lines.zh: 我翻开本子，草草翻过几页我懒得细看的笔记，才翻到我要找的那一部分。

lines.en: In addition to having a bit of information on all of the girls, it comes complete with their pictures as well.
lines.zh: 除了每个女孩的些许资料，上面还附带了她们的照片。

lines.en: Just one more convenience in the evergrowing and possibly infinite list of them, I guess.
lines.zh: 大概只是那张不断变长、也许无穷无尽的“便利清单”上的又一项吧。

lines.en: scene amiclass
{i}Ami Arakawa...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami Arakawa……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Ami is an adorable and extremely cute girl that I’ve known since she was born.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami 是个可爱到极点的女孩，我从她出生起就认识她了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}We’ve always been close, but it wasn't until after the accident that we became what we are now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我们一直很亲近，但直到那场事故之后，我们才变成现在这样。{/i}

lines.en: scene amibreak1
scene beforewefall2
scene dust5
scene bathscenebutnomorebath15
{i}Ami doesn't like talking about the accident.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami 不喜欢谈那场事故。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Neither do I.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我也不喜欢。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It should be avoided at all costs.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}无论如何都该避开这个话题。{/i}

lines.en: I guess this sort of doubles as...Sensei’s diary, or something?
lines.zh: 这么看来，这东西大概还兼作……Sensei 的日记之类的？

lines.en: This definitely doesn't seem like just school-related information thus far, but...
lines.zh: 到目前为止，这显然不只是学校相关的信息，不过……

lines.en: Why is a grown man keeping something like this in his room?
lines.zh: 一个成年男人为什么把这种东西放在自己房间里？

lines.en: It doesn't have something to do with the whole guidance counselor thing, does it?
lines.zh: 这该不会跟什么升学指导顾问的事有关吧？

lines.en: scene mayaclass
{i}Maya Makinami...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya Makinami……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maya is a strange girl who has never liked me and has always avoided me for seemingly no reason whatsoever.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 是个古怪的女孩，从来都不喜欢我，也总是毫无理由地躲着我。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She’s been coming to the house for several years now but, despite that, I know nothing about her and can't imagine I'll be finding anything out anytime soon.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她来家里已经好几年了，尽管如此，我对她一无所知，也想象不出短期内能了解到什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}All I know for sure is that she cares deeply for Ami and...is even more deeply troubled by my existence.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我能确定的只有一点：她很在乎 Ami，而且……我的存在让她更加困扰。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I should avoid her at all costs as well.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我也该不惜一切代价躲着她。{/i}

lines.en: Well, I guess that pretty much explains why I was treated the way I was earlier.
lines.zh: 嗯，这大概就解释了为什么刚才她那样对我。

lines.en: It's clear that Maya would agree with Sensei's final note in her entry, but...
lines.zh: 显然，Maya 会赞同 Sensei 在她那篇里写下的最后一句，不过……

lines.en: That doesn't stop me from wondering just what her deal is.
lines.zh: 这并不妨碍我好奇她到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: scene ayaneclass
{i}Ayane Amamiya...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane Amamiya……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Ayane is another one of Ami’s close friends that has been coming to the house for years now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 是 Ami 的另一位密友，同样来家里好些年了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She is...surprisingly open. Annoyingly open, even.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她……坦率得惊人。甚至可以说，坦率得让人头疼。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Open to the point where if I don't stop her from sharing her feelings in public, it could get me into a lot of trouble.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}坦率到如果我不拦着她在公共场合倾诉感情，可能会给我惹上大麻烦。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She’s incredibly flirtatious and often wanders off to talk to me instead of Ami and Maya while hanging out at the house.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她极其爱调情，在家里玩的时候，常常丢下 Ami 和 Maya 跑来找我说话。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Her parents have made several large donations to the[school] and her father is one of the few males left in the city but, despite that, Ayane bears little attachment to him.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她父母给 [school] 捐过好几笔巨款，她父亲也是城里为数不多留下来的男性之一，尽管如此，Ayane 对他几乎没什么感情。{/i}

lines.en: scene yumiclass
Yumi Yamaguchi...
lines.zh: Yumi Yamaguchi……

lines.en: {i}Yumi is the obligatory class delinquent.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 是班上少不了的问题少女。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She doesn't particularly seem to show any interest in associating with the other girls apart from picking fights with them on a near daily basis.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}除了几乎每天都要跟其他女孩吵架之外，她看起来对跟她们来往毫无兴趣。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The only one who seems to be an exception to that is Chika.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}唯一例外的似乎是 Chika。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She's been known to hang around the local arcade with a crowd of slightly older guys who are most likely Yakuza, but has since stopped going- likely due to the draft.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有人看见她常跟一群年纪稍大的男人在当地的游戏厅厮混，那伙人八成是黑道，不过她后来不去了——大概是因为征兵。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Her attitude seems to be getting worse every day and even calling her into my office doesn't seem to work anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她的态度似乎一天比一天恶劣，连把她叫进办公室谈话都不管用了。{/i}

lines.en: scene chikaclass
Chika Chosokabe...
lines.zh: Chika Chosokabe……

lines.en: {i}Unlike Yumi, Chika is actually quite popular with all of the girls and spends a lot of time getting to know them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}和 Yumi 不同，Chika 在所有女孩里其实相当受欢迎，也花很多时间去了解她们。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Despite her appearance, she's very bright and consistently ranks near the top of the class when she actually applies herself.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}别看她外表那样，她其实很聪明，只要真正用功，成绩就稳定排在班级前列。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The big issue is getting her to apply herself since she skips homeroom frequently to use her phone in the bathroom.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}最大的问题是怎么让她肯用心，因为她经常逃掉班会时间，躲进厕所玩手机。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Chika has a good heart, but is often too caught up in her own world to notice when the one around her is beginning to come undone.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 心地很好，但常常太沉迷于自己的世界，察觉不到周围的世界正在分崩离析。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotoclass
{i}Makoto Miyamura...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto Miyamura……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Makoto is the student council president, class representative, and self-proclaimed teacher’s assistant.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 是学生会主席、班长，以及自称的老师助手。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She seems to be almost immune to the opinions of others and has no problem sucking up to me at all times, likely due to admiration rather than an innate desire for a recommendation letter.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她似乎几乎不受他人看法的影响，而且随时都在讨好我，也毫无心理负担——大概是出于崇拜，而不是天生想要一封推荐信。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She’s the top student in her grade and has caused absolutely no problems whatsoever, often times keeping the entire class afloat when I am unable to.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她是年级里成绩最好的学生，从没惹过任何麻烦，还常常在我顾不过来的时候把整个班撑住。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Makoto's biggest flaw is that she goes above and beyond far too frequently, to the point where I believe it might be damaging to her.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 最大的缺点，是她太过频繁地超负荷付出，以至于我觉得这可能正在伤害她。{/i}

lines.en: scene futabaclass
{i}Futaba Fukuyama...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba Fukuyama……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Futaba is an extremely kindhearted girl, but greatly struggles with a variety of self-esteem issues and often elects to sit out of physical education as a result of them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 是个极其善良的女孩，却被各种自尊问题深深困扰，因此常常选择不参加体育课。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She is a constant target for Yumi's bullying, but is otherwise loved by the rest of the class and is always willing to lend an ear to anyone in need.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她是 Yumi 长期霸凌的对象，但除此之外，全班都很喜欢她，她也总是愿意倾听任何有需要的人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Futaba performs very well in Japanese Literature and spends most of her time reading, but she can get lost in daydreams at times and must be broken out of them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 日本文学成绩很好，大部分时间都在看书，但她有时会陷入白日梦，得有人把她拉出来。{/i}

lines.en: {i}In order for her to succeed, she will need to learn to love herself. Thankfully, she takes well to positive reinforcement and is significantly stronger than she looks.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}要想真正走下去，她得学会爱自己。幸好，她对正向鼓励很受用，也比看上去坚强得多。{/i}

lines.en: scene mikuclass
{i}Miku Maruyama...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku Maruyama……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Miku has a hard time figuring out when to stop talking. In fact, I don't think she has ever figured it out even once.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 很难搞明白什么时候该闭嘴。事实上，我觉得她一次都没搞明白过。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She has far too much energy for her own good and constantly needs to be reminded to either quiet down or stop running in circles around the classroom.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她精力过剩到对自己都没好处，总得不断提醒她安静点，或者别再绕着教室跑圈。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She excels in physical education and is arguably the strongest player on the school's soccer team.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她体育课表现出色，可以说还是校足球队里最强的球员。{/i}

lines.en: {i}When it comes to every other class or subject, however, she needs a significant amount of additional coaching.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可换成其他任何一门课或科目，她就需要大量的额外辅导。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Thankfully, she's very close with Makoto and seems to care deeply about keeping her happy.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}幸好，她和 Makoto 关系很好，似乎非常在意能否让 Makoto 开心。{/i}

lines.en: scene rinclass
{i}Rin Rokuhara...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin Rokuhara……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Rin might look like the cool, calm, and collected type, but she has proven to be a bit unpredictable and far too excitable more times than I can count.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 看起来像是那种又酷、又冷静、又从容的类型，但她已经无数次证明自己有点难以预测，而且太容易激动。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She goes through short periods of time where she doesn’t act like herself and has disappeared for days on several occasions.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她会短暂地变得不像她自己，还曾多次失踪好几天。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She’s hesitant to come to me for counseling and seems like the type to ignore her problems rather than make a genuine effort to resolve them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她不太愿意来找我咨询，看起来是那种宁愿无视问题、也不真正努力去解决的人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}That aside, she's universally liked by everyone in the class and has never been known to cause problems for anyone other than herself.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}除此之外，全班都喜欢她，也从不曾给除她自己以外的任何人制造过麻烦。{/i}

lines.en: scene sanaclass
{i}Sana Sakakibara...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana Sakakibara……{/i}

lines.en: {i}No one really knows anything about Sana other than Ayane.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}除了 Ayane，没人真正了解 Sana。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She's extremely quiet and vehemently refuses to talk under almost all circumstances, but it's less because she doesn't want to and more because she can't.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她极其安静，几乎在任何情况下都坚决不肯开口，但这与其说是不想说，不如说是说不出来。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It remains to be seen whether this is simply how she is or if there is something about her past that is causing her to be this way-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这到底只是她的本性，还是她的过去有什么让她变成了这样，还有待观察——{/i}

lines.en: {i}But without many opportunities to actually speak with her, I'm not sure if I'll ever really know anything or not.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但没有多少真正跟她说话的机会，我也不确定自己是否还能了解到什么。{/i}

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath16
So...that's my class, I guess.
lines.zh: 那么……这就是我的班了吧。

lines.en: It seems like there's a fair bit of diversity in terms of personalities, but I guess I won't be able to confirm anything for sure until I make it to school tomorrow, though.
lines.zh: 性格上似乎挺多样化，不过我想得等到明天去了学校才能确认。

lines.en: A few of the girls seem like they might be a bit harder to {i}crack{/i} than the others, but...seeing as this is apparently my life now, I'm sure I'll have plenty of time.
lines.zh: 有几个女孩看起来比其他人更难{i}攻克{/i}，不过……既然这显然已经成了我的人生，我相信时间还很充裕。

lines.en: The issue is just...figuring out who to talk to first.
lines.zh: 问题只在于……先找谁搭话。

lines.en: Sure, Ami would likely be the easiest out of everyone- and the most accessible too.
lines.zh: 当然，Ami 大概是所有人里最容易的——也是最唾手可得的。

lines.en: The problem is that Ami seems almost {i}too{/i} accessible- to the point where, even now, I feel like she's hovering right over my shoulder.
lines.zh: 问题是 Ami 几乎{i}太{/i}唾手可得了——以至于就算现在，我都觉得她正悬在我肩膀后面。

lines.en: : Do you remember everyone's names yet? Want me to quiz you?
lines.zh: : 你记住所有人的名字了吗？要我考考你吗？

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath17
: You're really quiet.
lines.zh: : 你可真安静。

lines.en: : Yeah. That's a special skill of mine.
lines.zh: : 对。这可是我的特殊技能。

lines.en: : But in my defense, Sensei, I {i}did{/i} knock like three times before coming in here.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，Sensei，我进来之前{i}可是敲了{/i}三次门呢。

lines.en: : And with how out of it you've been since we left school, I was worried your brain might have melted or something like that.
lines.zh: : 而且你从离开学校之后就一直魂不守舍，我还担心你的脑子是不是化了之类的。

lines.en: : You're lucky your loving niece was willing to come check on you rather than just calling an ambulance and letting them handle it.
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸你有个疼你的侄女愿意亲自来看看你，而不是直接叫辆救护车把事情丢给他们。

lines.en: : I'm flattered, really.
lines.zh: : 我受宠若惊，真的。

lines.en: scene bathscenebutnomorebath18
: Dinner's in the oven right now, so you can go ahead and take a bath while it's cooking.
lines.zh: : 晚饭正在烤箱里，你可以趁着做菜的工夫先去泡个澡。

lines.en: : I already warmed the water up for you...and I want to wait until right before I go to sleep to get in since that's what always makes my hair look best the next morning.
lines.zh: : 我已经帮你把水烧好了……我自己想等到临睡前再泡，因为那样第二天早上头发看起来最好看。

lines.en: : Given how much of it you have, I'm sure it takes the entire night to dry as well.
lines.zh: : 你有那么多头发，我敢肯定要晾一整晚才干得了。

lines.en: : Yup! I'm pretty sure that if I put it into a ponytail while it's still wet and swing it really hard, I can probably kill someone.
lines.zh: : 没错！我敢肯定，要是趁湿把头发扎成马尾然后用力甩，大概能把人打死。

lines.en: : Great. I can't foresee a future in which that ever needs to happen, but I'm glad that you've found a way to weaponize your body so early in life.
lines.zh: : 很好。我想不出未来什么时候会需要用到这招，不过我很高兴你年纪轻轻就找到了把自己的身体武器化的方法。

lines.en: : Sensei, you realize that every second you spend talking to me here is just making the bath cooler, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你该知道，你在这儿跟我多聊一秒，洗澡水就凉一分吧？

lines.en: : I know, I know. I'm going.
lines.zh: : 知道，知道。我这就去。

lines.en: : But before I get in...
lines.zh: : 不过在我进去之前……

lines.en: : Thank you, Ami. For...answering all of my questions today and...just immediately accepting my existence.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ami。谢谢你……今天回答了我所有的问题，还有……二话不说就接受了我的存在。

lines.en: : Saying it like that makes it sound like you didn't exist {i}until{/i} today, Sensei. And we both know that's not true at all.
lines.zh: : 这么说听着好像你{i}直到{/i}今天才存在似的，Sensei。而我们俩都知道根本不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess we do...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想我们确实知道……

lines.en: scene black
The bath is perfectly warm once I get in...and dinner is perfectly cooked once I get out.
lines.zh: 我泡进去时水温刚刚好……等我出来时，晚饭也做得刚刚好。

lines.en: It's an amazing first day here in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 在 Kumon-mi 的第一天，精彩得不可思议。

lines.en: But nothing this good can possibly last forever.
lines.zh: 但这么美好的事，不可能永远持续下去。

lines.en: And I know that all of the conveniences being passed out like promotional tissues will soon become too much to bear.
lines.zh: 我也知道，那些像发传单一样四处派发的便利，很快就会沉重得让人难以承受。

lines.en: There is no world so abundantly good...and I will not allow myself to be lured into believing such a world exists just because of a hot bath and a fresh plate of food.
lines.zh: 世上没有那样丰盛美好的世界……我也不会允许自己仅仅因为一池热水和一盘新鲜饭菜，就被诱骗着相信这样的世界存在。

lines.en: Tonight, I will sleep.
lines.zh: 今晚，我要睡去。

lines.en: And when I wake up-
lines.zh: 而当我醒来——

lines.en: If I wake up in {i}this{/i} world-
lines.zh: 如果我在{i}这{/i}世界里醒来——

lines.en: If none of this was a dream-
lines.zh: 如果这一切都不是梦——

lines.en: I will start a new life.
lines.zh: 我将开启一段新的人生。

lines.en: And I will do my best to cherish it.
lines.zh: 而我会尽全力去珍惜它。

lines.en: $ clichebath = True
$ ami_love += 1
{i}Congratulations! Ami’s affection has increased to 1!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！Ami 的好感度提升到了 1！{/i}

lines.en: {i}In Lessons in Love, affection points are used to unlock the next step in each girl’s story.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在《Lessons in Love》中，好感度点数用于解锁每个女孩故事的下一阶段。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Affection points may be gained through main story events and/or spending your free time with the girls.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}好感度点数可通过主线剧情事件和／或与女孩们共度自由时间来获得。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Some events are locked to progress with certain characters, so make sure to level up all of them and not neglect anyone!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有些事件被锁定在特定角色的进度上，所以一定要把每个人都提升上去，别冷落了谁！{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can view your affection with the girls through the progress menu at the bottom of your screen. This will also show you how much content is available for each character.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你可以通过屏幕底部的进度菜单查看与女孩们的好感度。那里也会显示每个角色还有多少内容可供体验。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For a more detailed look at each girl's content, you may view their character profiles. This is also where scene replays will be stored once you unlock them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}想更详细地了解每个女孩的内容，可以查看她们的角色档案。解锁后的场景回放也会存放在那里。{/i}

lines.en: {i}An event tracker for main events is accessible through the menu as well! And don't worry about skipping certain events if they aren't triggered in order.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}主线事件的事件追踪器同样可以通过菜单打开！如果某些事件没有按顺序触发，也不必担心跳过的问题。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Some events require very specific conditions to be met in order to trigger, so unless you see something crossed out in red, it is still obtainable.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有些事件需要满足非常特定的条件才会触发，所以除非你看到某条被红色划掉，否则它就仍然可以解锁。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, and did I mention that all events are replayable by clicking their respective titles in the tracker? Because they are!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦，我说过所有事件都能在追踪器里点击对应标题重看吗？因为它们确实可以！{/i}

lines.en: {i}This will come in handy once I start showing you how much I hate you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等我以后开始向你展示我有多讨厌你的时候，这个功能会派上用场的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Anyway! This marks the end of Day 1!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总之！第一天到此结束！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Your true journey begins now!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你真正的旅程现在才开始！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Enjoy your stay in Kumon-mi!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}祝你在 Kumon-mi 过得愉快！{/i}

lines.en: {i}And please accept this next scene as a token of my gratitude for spending time with me in here.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也请收下下面这一幕，作为你愿意陪我待在这里的一点谢意。{/i}

lines.en: $ totaldays += 1
$ day += 1
else:
jump firstfriday
